payload.question_text: Which model is a general-purpose image-generation model built on earlier DALL-E capabilities?

options.rationale: GPT-Image-1.5 is the advanced high-fidelity model. The general-purpose description belongs to GPT-Image-1.
options.better_fit: Choose this for high-fidelity branding or design work.

options.rationale: Mini is a lighter, cost-efficient GPT-Image-1 variant. It is optimized for lower cost or latency.
options.better_fit: Choose this for high-volume or internal work where cost and latency matter.

options.rationale: FLUX is an open-source family from Black Forest Labs. It is not the GPT model built on earlier DALL-E capabilities.
options.better_fit: Choose this when an open-source image-model family is desired.

options.rationale: Correct. GPT-Image-1 is the general-purpose model built on earlier DALL-E capabilities. It supports generation, variations, and editing.

payload.explanation: Correct. GPT-Image-1 is the general-purpose model.

payload.question_text: Which statements describe GPT-Image-1-Mini? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. GPT-Image-1-Mini is a lighter-weight GPT-Image-1 variant. Its design supports cost- and latency-focused needs.
Correct. GPT-Image-1-Mini is more cost-efficient. It is intended for cases where lower cost matters.

options.text: It supports the same core tasks
options.rationale: Correct. GPT-Image-1-Mini supports the same core image-generation tasks as GPT-Image-1. Its main difference is optimization for cost and latency.
Maximum fidelity is not Mini's main focus. GPT-Image-1.5 is the high-fidelity option.
options.better_fit: Choose this priority for high-accuracy branding and design work.

payload.explanation: Correct. Mini keeps core tasks while emphasizing lower cost and latency.

payload.question_text: GPT-Image-1 supports text-to-image generation, image variations, and precise image editing.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A creative app could leave out a capability GPT-Image-1 supports.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GPT-Image-1 can create images from text, make variations, and precisely edit images.

payload.explanation: Correct. GPT-Image-1 supports all three tasks.

payload.question_text: GPT-Image-1-Mini is a separate image-model family unrelated to GPT-Image-1.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A team could treat related models as unrelated choices.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GPT-Image-1-Mini is a cost-efficient GPT-Image-1 variant that supports the same core tasks.

payload.explanation: Correct. GPT-Image-1-Mini is a lighter variant of GPT-Image-1.

payload.question_text: Which statements describe GPT-Image-1.5? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. GPT-Image-1.5 supports precise image editing. This is useful when visual details matter.
Correct. GPT-Image-1.5 supports image-to-image generation. It can work from an image as well as from text.

options.text: It is optimized mainly for lowest cost
options.rationale: Reduced cost and latency are the primary focus of GPT-Image-1-Mini. GPT-Image-1.5 instead emphasizes quality and editing.
options.better_fit: Choose this priority for high-volume work where maximum fidelity is less important.

options.text: It is designed for high-fidelity creation
options.rationale: Correct. GPT-Image-1.5 targets high-fidelity, enterprise-grade creation. It is suited to visual-accuracy-focused work.

payload.explanation: Correct. GPT-Image-1.5 focuses on high-quality creation and editing.

payload.question_text: What does an image-generation model do?

options.text: Matches an existing image to text
options.rationale: This describes image analysis rather than image generation. Analysis starts with an existing image and interprets it.
options.better_fit: Use this when you need to describe or classify an existing image.

options.rationale: Video generation produces moving video content. Image generation produces still images.
options.better_fit: Use this when the desired output is a video clip.

options.rationale: Correct. Image generation creates a new visual that corresponds to a written description.

options.text: Answers questions about images and text
options.rationale: This describes a multimodal understanding task. It does not specifically create a new image.
options.better_fit: Use this when an uploaded image must be interpreted with written instructions.

payload.explanation: Correct. Image generation turns a written description into a new image.

payload.question_text: GPT-Image-1.5 is mainly optimized for reduced cost when maximum visual fidelity is not important.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A high-detail brand task could be assigned to the wrong model focus.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GPT-Image-1.5 is for high-fidelity, accurate visuals and editing; Mini prioritizes cost or latency.

payload.explanation: Correct. That cost-and-latency focus describes GPT-Image-1-Mini.

payload.question_text: Text-to-image inferencing generates visual output from a written description.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A written design brief would not be recognized as a request for a new image.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Text-to-image inferencing means generating visual output from a written description.

payload.explanation: Correct. Text-to-image inferencing creates a visual from words.

options.rationale: FLUX is separate from the GPT-Image family. It is an open-source family from Black Forest Labs.
options.better_fit: Use this description for GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, or GPT-Image-1-Mini.

options.rationale: Correct. FLUX is an open-source family of image-generation models. It was created by Black Forest Labs.
FLUX generates images from text prompts. It is not a video-generation model.
options.better_fit: Use this description for a model that generates video clips.

options.rationale: FLUX is a model family rather than an API. Its members generate images from prompts.
options.better_fit: Use an API description for a programmatic interface that sends requests.

payload.explanation: Correct. FLUX is an open-source image-model family.

payload.question_text: Which actions are part of the image-generation API flow? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. A text prompt describes the requested image. It is included in the image-generation request.
Polling is part of an asynchronous video-generation workflow. The image flow decodes returned image data and saves it.
options.better_fit: Use this after creating an asynchronous video-generation job.

options.rationale: Correct. The image_generation tool produces the image result. Its response contains returned image data.
Correct. Returned Base64 data is decoded into image bytes. Those bytes can then be saved as PNG.

payload.explanation: Correct. These actions are part of the image-generation flow.

payload.question_text: FLUX is a GPT-Image model created by Microsoft Foundry.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The model family could be credited to the wrong organization.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: FLUX was created by Black Forest Labs and is separate from the GPT-Image family.

payload.explanation: Correct. FLUX is a separate open-source family from Black Forest Labs.

payload.question_text: Returned Base64 image data can be decoded and saved as a PNG file.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Saving encoded text directly would not produce the intended PNG.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Decode Base64 before writing the resulting image bytes to a PNG file.

payload.explanation: Correct. Decoding changes returned Base64 text into image bytes that can be saved.
